description: Describes how to render a short, human-readable preview of a record of a given collection (e.g. the text of a post), as a template string.

collection.description: Record collection NSID this preview is for.

template.description: Template producing a human-readable preview of such a record. Placeholders: {repo} (handle if known else DID), {handle}, {did}, {rkey}, {collection}, and {value.<dot.path>} into the record body; an optional '|transform' or '->' cross-record dereference (see com.example.app.handlers). e.g. {value.text} for an app.bsky.feed.post.
